## Features
- **Relics tab knows what is worn**: the four equipped slots are marked `worn` and listed first; the rest of
  the pile follows, each with a score.
- **Suggested loadout**: the four relics that best feed *your* ancients. A relic's worth is the strength of
  its bonuses relative to the same bonuses on your other relics, weighted by how much you have invested in
  the ancient each bonus belongs to (never-summoned ancients count for little). Swaps are listed by name.
- Power Five levels read `L3000 · target 2075`, with a note that heroes gain 4x damage every 25 levels, so
  the target is an efficiency ceiling, not a cap.
